I've answered Dana in a thread on her #north-random message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **ticket #4092**.

Ilse posted it in that channel yesterday (Oct 13, 11:55), saying IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

I couldn't find the ticket anywhere else Dana has access to: #help-it-ops is empty, and nothing else I checked mentions it. So I couldn't tell her whether it's still open.
